sources.title: GraspNet通用物体抓取
sources.snippet: GraspNet is an open project for general object grasping that is continuously enriched. It currently contains: GraspNet-1Billion: a benchmark that contains 190 cluttered and complex scenes captured by two popular RGBD cameras (Kinect Azure and RealSense D435), bringing 97,280 images in total.
